mapper.sql: SELECT d_id, id, person_name, pass_time, person_no, index_path_name, pass_time_exc, pass_time_ms, site_name, attendance_identification, attendance_identification_absolute, type FROM h_dist
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h_dist (id, person_name, pass_time, person_no, index_path_name, pass_time_exc, pass_time_ms, site_name, attendance_identification, attendance_identification_absolute, type) VALUES (#{id}, #{person_name}, #{pass_time}, #{person_no}, #{index_path_name}, #{pass_time_exc}, #{pass_time_ms}, #{site_name}, #{attendance_identification}, #{attendance_identification_absolute}, #{type})
mapper.select: SELECT count(DISTINCT ( person_name )) as num,site_name FROM h_dist WHERE pass_time >= DATE_SUB( NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE ) GROUP BY site_name
